invented.quote: The Long Dark Season: Keep the Light Burning
invented.why: The brief does not give a title or subtitle for the game.

invented.quote: The supply boat won't come again until spring. The oil has to last, the children have to eat, and ships need the light every night.
invented.why: The brief only says you see a lighthouse keeper's family through a winter, without mentioning a supply boat, oil, children, or ships needing the light every night.

invented.quote: on an island at the edge of the map.
invented.why: The brief does not state that the lighthouse is located on an island.

invented.quote: Each turn you decide what gets done today and what has to wait: fixing the lamp, rationing the stores, caring for someone who's sick, or going out in the storm.
invented.why: The brief gives no details about the turn structure, time scale, or specific in-game actions like fixing the lamp, rationing stores, caring for the sick, or going out in a storm.

invented.quote: No two winters play out the same, and the hardest choices often have nothing to do with the light.
invented.why: The brief does not mention game replayability or what the hardest choices in the game involve.

invented.quote: Tested at hundreds of tables, one game at a time
invented.why: The brief states there have been 140 playtest sessions, which is not 'hundreds'.

invented.quote: families, first-timers, longtime hobby gamers and solo players.
invented.why: The brief only mentions that about 60 different people playtested the game, without describing their backgrounds or how they played.
The brief does not state that changes were made after every playtest session.

invented.quote: The rest: platform and payment fees, plus a reserve for freight and surprises
invented.why: The brief does not say what the remaining funds in the budget are allocated for, and the $17,400 manufacturing quote plus $13,500 for shipping 1,500 copies at $9 each already exceeds the $28,000 goal.

invented.quote: The goal covers what it takes to produce the game and get it to you. It doesn't include any pay for me.
invented.why: The brief does not state whether the creator is taking any pay or if the $28,000 goal covers all production and shipping costs.

invented.quote: If we go past the goal, the extra money gives the project a safety margin before any stretch goals.
invented.why: The brief does not mention stretch goals or how funds raised beyond the goal will be used.

invented.quote: To lower that risk, I locked in the manufacturing quote before launch, budgeted shipping per copy, and built a reserve into the goal.
invented.why: The brief mentions having a factory quote and an approximate shipping cost, but does not say the quote is locked in or that a financial reserve was built into the $28,000 goal.

invented.quote: This game has been through four winters of playtesting.
invented.why: The brief only states that playtesting has been happening 'since 2023' and does not specify that it spanned four winters.
